metadata.scenario_context: Emily, a full-time working mother, is planning a birthday party for her children to improve their quality time together.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Indonesia strongly agree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Indonesia strongly disagree that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bringing chrysanthemums to Emily's party.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether that a mother works for pay and the children suffer.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss what gift to buy for Emily's children's birthday party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the concept that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about bringing some chrysanthemums to Emily's party? They could really brighten up the place. 

Also, I can't help but wonder... don't you think that when a mother works for pay, the children suffer?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Chrysanthemums could be nice, but I think getting toys or books might be a better gift for the kids. They really need something to enjoy and play with. 

About mothers working... I don't agree that children suffer. In Indonesia, many families thrive with working mothers. It teaches children responsibility and independence. It’s not as simple as saying they suffer.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I see your point about toys and books; they do sound great for the kids. But, you know, deep down, we are all the same when it comes to wanting what's best for children. I get that many families can thrive with working mothers, and that's wonderful. Still, people are pretty much motivated by the same things—ensuring their children have time and attention. At the end of the day, we all want children to feel loved and supported. Don't you think?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim

They learn resilience and ambition, which is important too.
